title: Foundations of Safe and Effective Parenting
learningObjectives: Understand the core principles of safe parenting
Identify harmful vs healthy parenting behaviours
Build a foundation for consistent, nurturing care
summary: This course introduces the essential principles of safe, stable, and nurturing parenting.

title: Understanding Child Development
learningObjectives: Recognise key stages of child development
Understand emotional, social, and cognitive growth
Adapt parenting strategies to developmental needs
summary: A practical guide to how children grow and what they need at each stage.

title: Emotional Regulation for Parents
learningObjectives: Use regulation strategies to stay calm
summary: Parents learn to manage their own emotions so they can respond safely and predictably.

title: Building Secure Attachment
summary: A deep dive into creating emotional safety and secure bonds with children.

title: Positive Communication Skills
learningObjectives: Help children feel heard and valued
summary: Parents learn practical communication tools that improve cooperation and trust.

title: Healthy Boundaries and Routines
summary: A practical course on creating stability, predictability, and safe limits.

title: Managing Challenging Behaviour
learningObjectives: Understand the causes of challenging behaviour
summary: Evidence‑based tools for managing behaviour without punishment or harm.

title: Strengthening Parent–Child Connection
summary: Parents learn connection‑building strategies that improve long‑term outcomes.

title: Co‑Parenting and Shared Care
summary: Tools for working together even when relationships are strained or separated.

title: Supporting Children Through Stress
learningObjectives: Recognise signs of stress in children
Support children through change and uncertainty
summary: Parents learn how to help children cope with anxiety, transitions, and big feelings.

title: Cultural, Family, and Community Strengths
summary: A strengths‑based course that honours culture, identity, and community support.

title: Parent Growth and Long‑Term Change
summary: A future‑focused course that helps parents maintain growth and build a safe family future.
